name: Spit
tagline: No turns: both players play at once, racing to empty their piles onto the middle.
rulesSummary: Each player gets half the deck and lays out five piles of 1 to 5 cards. The top cards (your hand here) are face up. The rest of your cards are your spit pile.

Both call Spit! to turn a card from each spit pile onto the middle. Then there are no turns: play any of your top cards onto either middle pile if it's one rank up or down. Ace and king are next to each other. Tap a card, then a pile, or swipe it up.
When you play a top card, the card beneath turns up. A top card can move into an empty space.
When neither of you can go, both call Spit! again.

Clear your five piles and both race to slap a middle pile. Whoever slaps first takes that pile, so slap the smaller one! The other player takes the other. Gather up, lay out again and play another round.
With fewer than 15 cards you lay out what you can and have no spit pile. Clear your piles with no spit pile left and you win.
